bugs.text: update() receives dt in milliseconds (16.67) but game logic treats dt as frames: shots, entries, dives, timers and explosions run ~16x too fast. In a node simulation of update() the first game reaches game over 1.35 s after Enter and returns to the title at 1.6 s; every post-Enter screenshot shows only the title screen.
startDive clears capturedRef, so shooting a diving boss can never free the captive; rescue and the dual fighter can never happen.
Challenging-stage enemies are wrapped with wrapX so they never leave the screen; the stage only ends if all 40 are shot (soft-lock).
Formation sway/breath phases never advance; the formation is static.
recolor() targets lowercase letters that do not exist: no wing-flap frames, and the boss never changes colour after its first hit.
Returning divers step 36 px per tick and only stop at d<3, so they can jitter around their slot forever and never re-join (cannot dive again).
Enemy bullets move 36.7 px per tick, tunnelling through the 8 px player hitbox most of the time.
Escorts are auto-destroyed and scored when the boss dies; the first boss hit awards an extra 150.
Challenging-stage NUMBER OF HITS/BONUS texts are cleared by startStage in the same tick; the wave bonus is floor(hits/8)*1000, not per whole wave.
The tractor beam fires from the formation slot without a dive; the captured ship is not red and is not pulled up.
Stage badges are one box per stage labelled by index (1,5,10,...), not the arcade denomination breakdown.

summary: The file is tidy and well sectioned, with a correct-looking fixed-timestep rAF loop, a clean title screen, starfield and HUD, and code for most Galaga systems. But the loop hands update() a 16.67 ms step that almost all game logic treats as a single frame, so entries, dives, bullets, timers, explosions and screens run about 16 times too fast. The game is over within roughly 1.4 s of pressing Enter and drops back to the title, which is all the play-test screenshots ever show. Beyond that, the signature mechanics are broken: the captive can never be rescued because startDive clears the boss's capturedRef, so the dual fighter is unreachable. The captured ship never fires, the formation never sways or breathes, the wing-flap and boss colour-change sprites are identical no-op copies, and challenging-stage enemies wrap forever. It looks like Galaga on the title screen but cannot be played as a game.
